newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Earthgrains to invest 2 bln esc in Portugal.
newsitem.headline: Earthgrains to invest 2 bln esc in Portugal.

text.p: U.S. Earthgrains Co said it would invest 2.0 billion escudos in a food factory in Portugal.
Earthgrains, which markets bread products under the Bimbo brandname in Portugal and Spain, expects the factory in central Portugal to start production by the middle of 1998.
Earthgrains said the investment would enable it to increase its market share in Portugal and consolidate its leading share in Spain. It currently has Portuguese market share of 22.4 percent.
Bimbo Portugal had 1996 sales of 2.8 billion escudos, up 10 percent.
